registered concrete producer: Reskillable @Mod constructor installs API/provider; preInit dispatches sided proxy. CommonProxy registers LevelLockHandler/PlayerData events, initializes config and PacketHandler; postInit setupLocks builds actual keys. Registry subscriber creates/registers skills including concrete attack. Default config includes iron_sword wildcard attack5. Skill enabled/default cap32 and default PlayerSkillInfo level1 establish a concrete conditional denial example with that config, not only abstract callbacks. ItemInfo equality ignores metadata in hash but honors wildcard in equality, matching actual sword metadata; NBT/mod lock helpers fully read as context0.
actual qualification refusal: LivingAttackEvent with true source EntityPlayer reads that actor current MAINHAND at damage event time, not necessarily original projectile weapon. genericEnforce skips noncancelable/null/empty/creative; default enforceFakePlayers includes fake denial but suppresses fake feedback, alternative skips fake. PlayerData.matchStats returnsfalse at first unmet requirement. Event is canceled and tellPlayer sends only to EntityPlayerMP. Default branch cancels before send; alternate sends before cancel. Other block/use/armor routes share categories but are not additional families. Current armor route is not canceling event; it copies/returns or drops invalid armor, clears armor slot then sends. No final aggregate result after every other mod handler is claimed.
item plus category transport: MessageLockedItem constructor stores stack reference, not copy; byte codec serializes ItemStack and UTF8 message key only. No failing requirement, threshold, server level, target UUID, world, nonce or action generation. PacketHandler registers actual CLIENT handler. onMessage schedules on Minecraft task queue, handleMessage calls HUDHandler.setLockMessage. No local player/world/current item revalidation before updating static slot. ByteBufUtils/native network scheduling internals not expanded; do not assert enqueue-time immutable stack snapshot.
separate live profile data: Login PlayerData.sync→API→ReskillableModAccess sends MessageDataSync with saveToNBT snapshot of SkillLevels. Client scheduled handler resolves current player through ClientProxy and loadFromNBT→PlayerSkillInfo overwrites level/points/unlocks for included skills. MessageLevelUp actual server handler can levelUp then saveAndSync after its gates; exact XP-helper internals not expanded or credited. No action ID binds these data packets to a particular MessageLockedItem. ConfigHandler reads local lock configuration; config-change load only replaces pending configLocks and does not itself call setupLocks. No same-time configuration/version field in refusal packet.
real client consumer recomputes explanation: ClientProxy registers HUDHandler and ClientTickHandler. On overlay ALL while lockTime>0, HUD reads current local player data and LevelLockHandler.getSkillLock(lockedItem) every render. Draws translated refusal category header red, then skill icons and requested level numbers red/green according to current local skill level. GuiSkills.drawSkill uses current profile rank and texture; RenderHelper submits concrete textured quad. Thus packet reports rejection category/item while detailed condition explanation is reconstructed from current local definitions and independently synced profile, not server failure witness. It lists all local skill/advancement requirements, not only the one that failed.
render coverage and early exit boundaries: RequirementRegistry supports skill, adv and trait; HUD separates only SkillRequirement and AdvancementRequirement. Trait/custom requirements still contribute restriction count/box size but are absent from shown detail list. Advancement icons/text show no achieved-state color check. An unresolved advancement causes return after outer pushMatrix and before matching final popMatrix; null display has no guard. This is a static incomplete-restore path, not a runtime graphics failure claim. Ordinary main skill text calls font renderer; translation resources/nativeGL/pixels not evaluated. No asset changed.
explicit lifespan and exits: setLockMessage replaces static item/message and sets40 on every receipt, with no dedup or throttle. END client tick decrements only when currentScreen null or doesGuiPauseGame false. World-null branch only PlayerDataHandler.cleanup; no HUD clear, dimension/actor key, dead-player clear, successful retry clear or item-switch clear. lockTime<=0 prevents drawing; stored item/message refs are retained. Last<10 uses partialTicks alpha clamped minimum0.05. Repeated receipts can prolong display; pausing can preserve remaining clock. Rendering is not explicitly filtered Pre/Post beyond ElementType.ALL, so do not assert exactly one draw per frame.

complete_semantic_decision_read.preservation: PlayerData构造为每注册Skill建默认level1并respec，load仅对存在的skill键加载，缺整组保留构造或旧内存值，不主动清未出现技能；PlayerSkillInfo加载整数直接赋值、clear解锁后重建，不调用onUnlock。getLevel消费时将<=0校正1、>cap校正cap，但getRank/isCapped/saveToNBT可直接用原值，skillPoints无对应clamp。getKey表达式实际是hashCode << (1+sideOffset)，不是UUID或保证唯一ID；同key缓存WR不是本player就save旧数据→remove→递归get新对象并load→用旧快照load覆盖。cleanup仅每END移除weakref已空项目，未见全会话清理/显式Clone事件，原生PlayerPersisted重生如何复制未在本源验证。 Master: 主责全文读166唯一方法及14声明，4完整context块，官方fixed commit/tree/blob/方法AST逐项核验。一个PlayerPersisted SkillableData永久技能档家族1，8技能/17trait/等级/点数/同步/装备锁/特性均不拆，非泛基础设施。getKey实际hashCode左移(1+side)且WR对象不同时serialize旧对象→删除cache→新构造load→旧快照覆盖，不能说按UUID安全跨死亡Clone；cleanup只清空WR。现行dot↔colon编码不是未知老namespace兼容alias。load只处理出现skill不清未出现旧值，unlockables按key集合无视false，未知registry忽略并新compound重写丢弃；非法ResourceLocation未逐项隔离。完整实际等级门槛与扣XP/点数流程已读，未知skill/null、parentSkill关联未验证只记静态限制。永久解锁与根entityData Undershirt200tickCD分开，符合本修复永久/瞬态边界，但本源未出现Clone回调不宣称死亡已验收。来源Skillable旧仓重定向官方Reskillable不另计；ExperienceHelper OpenMods派生只支持0，与已有其他技能树不同实际owner实现非换键clone。

full_chain.stage: registered actual trait and local input hooks
full_chain.observation: Existing ReskillableRegistryHandler.registerTraits actually constructs TraitSidestep. Constructor binds agility, default cost10, agility26/defense20 requirements and registers this instance on event bus only on physical client. Trait/Unlockable obtains config and actual parent skill. This subscription is separate from PlayerData.forEachEventHandler ability dispatch and occurs without an explicit enabled guard in Sidestep. OnKeyDown later checks unlocked membership and not sneaking; no isEnabled check there. Existing disabled/unknown profile rules not changed.

Existing ClientProxy key-binding registration plus newly read KeyBindings opens actual GuiSkills; full remainder GuiSkills click opens GuiSkillInfo. Skill-info hover computes not-unlocked and enough-points; left click sends MessageUnlockUnlockable. Registered SERVER handler obtains current context player, registry skill/unlockable, checks not already unlocked, points, matchStats and cancelable Pre, then PlayerSkillInfo.unlock subtracts cost/adds object and calls onUnlock; Post follows. saveAndSync is after conditional, so rejected purchase can sync unchanged. Existing MessageDataSync delivers included unlock registry keys into current local profile; that same isUnlocked(this) is input gate. Sender not arbitrary abstract callback. No parent-skill validation/unknown-ID robustness or survival-economy guarantee added.

onKeyDown returns while cd>0, otherwise dereferences current mc.player/profile without explicit null guard and skips locked/sneaking. It does not inspect which key generated event, event press/release state, currentScreen or a release edge. If left key is currently held, stores global ClientTickHandler.ticksInGame into leftDown, compares new-old<4 and calls dodge(left); else right analog. Left wins when both held. No >=0 bound or first-sample initialized flag; default last values0. Timestamp is stored before dodge checks, so failed motion attempt can prime another held-key event. This is event sampling, not proved two distinct presses.

dodge requires not flying, onGround, moveForward<0 and sprint key physically down; input caller already checks unlocked/not sneaking/cd. It computes yaw-facing horizontal unit vector, cross with vertical sign for side and scales1.25. Writes motionX/motionY/motionZ absolutely (Y0), then cd20. No target, damage cancellation, immunity interval, resistance lookup, server request, reply or motion rollback is coded in this local path. Public dodge itself lacks unlocked/sneak/cd gate, but only actual internal caller observed; no external misuse claimed.

Reused ClientTickHandler END increments ticksInGame only if no GUI or GUI does not pause. Sidestep.clientTick independently decrements cd>0 on every delivered END event, without checking screen/world/player/eligibility. Thus if END events are delivered while a pausing screen freezes ticksInGame, recharge can finish while last-input difference stays small. Native event delivery frequency under pause not inspected, so state conditional, not reproduced timing exploit. Both clocks are session objects/fields with no shown world-change reset; leftDown/rightDown andcd have no per-player dimension identity or explicit death/lock clear.

Trait itself subscribes RenderGameOverlayEvent.Post ALL. If player not flying, width=min(int((cd-partialTicks)*2),40); positive width draws fixed gray track and white remaining bar via Gui.drawRect. At cd0 width nonpositive and bar suppressed; no input timestamps cleared. HUD does not require currently unlocked/enabled and has no null-player guard. Flight hides bar while cooldown continues, not a reset; there is no server feedback receipt. Buffer/color requests inspected only, no visual/game/audio execution.
